id.instruksi: Satu putaran tukar-tetangga: dari kiri ke kanan, bandingkan dua kue bersebelahan dan tukar bila yang kiri lebih besar. Jalankan sampai ujung kanan, lalu pilih hasilnya.

en.instruksi: One pass of neighbour swaps: from left to right, compare two cakes side by side and swap them if the left one is bigger. Go all the way to the right end, then choose the result.
en.q1: Cakes in a row, sizes: 6, 3, 8, 2. What is the order after ONE pass of neighbour swaps?
en.q2: Cakes in a row, sizes: 4, 7, 1, 5. What is the order after ONE pass of neighbour swaps?

en.q9: Cakes in a row, sizes: 3, 1, 2. How many passes of neighbour swaps until they are all sorted smallest first?
